::: {.lead}
Whether you're planning an event, commissioning a column, exploring an advisory engagement, or just want to talk economics and education — I'd be glad to hear from you.
:::

## Send a message

```{=html}
<!-- Form posts to Formspree (form id: mppzlgdr). Submission is handled by JS below so the
     visitor stays on the page and sees a confirmation; it falls back to a normal POST if JS is off. -->
<form class="contact-form" id="contactForm" action="https://formspree.io/f/mppzlgdr" method="POST">
  <input type="hidden" name="_subject" value="New message from parthachatterjee.net">
  <div class="cf-row">
    <label>Name<input type="text" name="name" required></label>
    <label>Email<input type="email" name="email" required></label>
  </div>
  <label>What's this about?
    <select name="topic">
      <option>Speaking invitation</option>
      <option>Writing / commentary</option>
      <option>Advisory enquiry</option>
      <option>Media / interview</option>
      <option>Something else</option>
    </select>
  </label>
  <label>Message<textarea name="message" rows="5" required></textarea></label>
  <button type="submit" class="btn-primary-cta">Send message</button>
  <p class="cf-status" id="cfStatus" role="status" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
</form>

<style>
  .cf-status{margin-top:1rem;padding:.75rem 1rem;border-radius:8px;font-size:.95rem;}
  .cf-status.cf-ok{background:#e8f5ec;color:#1e5631;border:1px solid #bfe3cb;}
  .cf-status.cf-err{background:#fdecea;color:#8a2a1e;border:1px solid #f3c6bf;}
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  var form = document.getElementById('contactForm');
  if (!form) return;
  var status = document.getElementById('cfStatus');
  form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    var btn = form.querySelector('button[type=submit]');
    var label = btn.textContent;
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Sending…';
    status.hidden = true;
    fetch(form.action, {
      method: 'POST',
      body: new FormData(form),
      headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
    }).then(function (resp) {
      if (resp.ok) {
        form.reset();
        status.className = 'cf-status cf-ok';
        status.textContent = "Thank you — your message is on its way. I'll be in touch.";
        status.hidden = false;
      } else {
        return resp.json().then(function (data) {
          status.className = 'cf-status cf-err';
          status.textContent = (data.errors && data.errors.length)
            ? data.errors.map(function (x) { return x.message; }).join(', ')
            : "Sorry — something went wrong. Please email me directly at partha.chatterjee@snu.edu.in.";
          status.hidden = false;
        });
      }
    }).catch(function () {
      status.className = 'cf-status cf-err';
      status.textContent = "Sorry — a network error occurred. Please email me directly at partha.chatterjee@snu.edu.in.";
      status.hidden = false;
    }).finally(function () {
      btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = label;
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```

Prefer email? Write to me directly at
[partha.chatterjee@snu.edu.in](mailto:partha.chatterjee@snu.edu.in) — for speaking, the more you can tell me about your **audience, theme, and date**, the better.

## Advisory

I take on a small number of advisory engagements with institutions and organizations on economic strategy and higher-education transformation. If that's of interest, mention it in your message and I'll be in touch.
